src: moving-color pixels of the two-color checkerboard; the teal edge marker identifies the moving-color parity
path: straight along each row toward a left/right marker edge, or along each column toward a top/bottom marker edge
trajectory: stably compact all moving-color pixels to the marker edge in every parallel line
transform: preserve the teal marker at its edge cell; on the marker row or column recolor swept vacated cells maroon unless occupied by the final compacted line
